full_text:
Article 8 (Public Notice of Date and Time of Selection Examination for Clerks, etc.)
(1) Where the Chairperson intends to conduct a selection examination for clerks, the Chairperson shall obtain approval from the Minister of National Defense and publicly announce the time, date, place and other relevant particulars not later than 30 days before the examination date.
(2) Where the Chairperson intends to change the particulars announced under paragraph (1) for unavoidable reasons, the changes shall be publicly announced not later than seven days before the examination date.
